country_setting: China (single centre, Suining Central Hospital, Suining, Sichuan)
question_source: adapted patient questions
presentation_scope: single condition that presents in primary care
model_version_date: public web interface; evaluated 4-5 August 2026, no-search conditions
raters: 2 independent blinded clinical reviewers (endocrinology attending, 10 years; orthopedic attending, 12 years); domain discrepancies adjudicated by a blinded senior orthopedic chief physician (20 years)
rating_scale: Safety severity graded 0-3 (0=no safety error; 1=minor; 2=potentially consequential; 3=potential for immediate serious harm); grades 2 and 3 classified as major safety errors
funding_conflicts: Supported by the Guidance Project of Suining Health Science and Technology Program in 2025 (Project No. 25ZDJB05); conflicts: authors declared absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest
notes: Primary outputs only: no harmful recommendation or prespecified major safety error in primary outputs (0/100 overall; Results, Referral agreement and safety outcomes) or in the additional repeated outputs (0/40, exploratory repeated-generation substudy, not extracted). Cases were translated, de-identified, curated cases from real patient records, evenly distributed across the 4 IWGDF risk categories. Safety assessment recorded fabricated clinical findings and under-referral as elements, but no per-arm fabrication or under-triage counts are printed. Referral-need agreement for this interface (Table 2): 18/20 (disagreement direction not split into under- vs over-referral per arm).
